verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents per-agent branches of production data on isolated compute that agents can experiment on and then discard (docs-13). It also offers isolated read-only agent compute that cannot affect production traffic (docs-12), a free dev instance (docs-10, docs-40), and CHKit commands to test schema and pipelines in CI (docs-11). Together these cover the core of a sandbox that doesn't touch production. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on branch write isolation and copy-on-write semantics over shared S3, setup and lifecycle details for branches, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond homepage marketing claims.
